spanish: Y señalarán a ustedes a límite hacia oriente desde Hatsar Einán a Shefamá.

findings.issue: H184 hithpael (sequential perfect 2mp) licenses desire or longing; señalarán substitutes an unlicensed marking sense and closes that openness.
The directional suffix is translated by a and also absorbed into the proper name Shefamá.

notes: a ustedes, límite, hacia oriente, and desde Hatsar Einán follow their tokens; señalarán is the ustedes 2pl form.
